messages:
maria-ml: Heads up — PR #2437's GPU CI (tests/gpu/batch_infer) just hit a kernel watchdog timeout on linux-gpu-xlarge. Failing job: https://ci.redwood.ai/ci/7890

maria-ml: Log snippet:
```
[  +0.000s] ERROR: kernel watchdog timeout: GPU reset required
E: XID 79 GPU hung
stack trace: ...
```

maria-ml: This only started after merging @tao-eng's changes (commit abc1234). Can someone rerun and/or bisect? :eyes:

tao-eng: On it. Can you paste last 200 lines of container dmesg and nvidia-smi output? Also which CUDA image?

maria-ml: Image: docker.redwood.ai/redwood/cuda:12.2-rt-535.XX. dmesg snippet:
```
NVRM: Xid(79): GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ +1.234s] watchdog: GPU hung in block/fill loop
```

kevin-ci: I've kicked a rerun (job 7891). If it flakes again we should bisect commits between abc1234..def5678. Also try reduced batch size env TEST_BATCH=1 to see if it's OOM.

ci-bot: Rerun #7891 started by kevin-ci — https://ci.redwood.ai/ci/7891

nate-sre: Driver mismatch suspicion — 535.XX on host might disagree with CUDA runtime in container. Can you run `nvidia-smi -q` on the runner and check kernel module version? If host driver is older, kernel-level hang can occur.

jane-qa: Quick workaround: pin runner image to cuda:12.1-rt-525.XX — we saw stability there. Not a fix but helps unblock.

maria-ml: Rerun passed once (7891) but failed on second attempt. I'll start a git bisect tomorrow unless someone beats me to it. For immediate PR unblock, I'll push a change to lower TEST_BATCH and pin the image to 12.1. Thanks all :pray:

kevin-ci: If you bisect, include the minimal repro test command and tag me. I can automate bisect with CI matrix.

maria-ml: Will do — thx!
